notes: RGB + moves again. 58.9.7 stopped its glow from painting colours that clashed with the theme by keeping the app’s accents frozen on the theme’s own pink and blue and sliding only the glow between them — which fixed the odd green and magenta edges but left the whole app looking like a frozen pink theme ("its still pink and hasn’t changed"). RGB + now runs the same cycle as RGB (animated): the accents and the glow are always the SAME two colours, so the app, its buttons, its borders and the edge glow all move together and nothing can clash with anything

What RGB + adds on top is unchanged: the bass-reactive glow suite (edge lines, top and bottom bands, corner fades, the mini turntable’s ambient glow) and its own settings. Cycle speed is still adjustable in Settings, and the cycle still opens on the theme’s own pink and blue rather than snapping to red on every start
